defects.description: Deferred syscall.Kill(pid, SIGKILL) runs after the body already reaped pid with Wait4, so it can signal a reused PID belonging to an unrelated process; the same check-then-kill TOCTOU exists in jobctl_test.go shell.close/reapLeftover after the shell may have reaped the job.

Every continue (orphaned-stop undo, forwarded third-party SIGCONT, poller fg continue) is killpg(-child) rather than the stopped child only, so grandchildren in the child's group that were stopped independently are also resumed, and the orphaned-group emulation delivers a SIGCONT that plain exec would not.
A child stop by SIGTTOU is mirrored as SIGTSTP, so $? is 128+SIGTSTP instead of 128+SIGTTOU as with plain exec (documented in REPORT known gaps; outside the hidden S1-S5 coverage).

Mirroring keys only on terminal foreground; a non-shell parent that places the launcher's group in the foreground gets a third-party stop mirrored and the launcher is never continued, and a background job's third-party stop is listed Running where plain exec shows Stopped (bg then does not continue the child). Documented as known gaps.
Scenario tests synchronize with fixed sleeps (for example 600 ms before typing after fg, 2.5 s waits) and take about 90 s; they are differential against plain exec but timing-sensitive under load.
